intent: Register the measured gdlint (gdtoolkit 4.5.0) as a named GDScript style lint row and make it a default gate for any compiled contract whose project carries the root godot.toml convention, following the godot_boundaries pattern and the command shape scripts/godot_check.py reports. Fail-closed when the tool is unavailable; contracts without the convention are unaffected. The recorded posture that gdtoolkit is absent from the locked harness environment is preserved or explicitly revised with review, never silently changed. Evidence: unlinted one-shot code showed 516 findings, mature Pixelorama showed zero.

requirements.LINT-GD-ROW: A named gdlint check row exists in check_commands and exits nonzero on violations, mirroring the godot_boundaries row shape.
requirements.LINT-GD-DEFAULT: Any compiled contract whose project carries the root godot.toml convention runs the gdlint gate by default; contracts without the convention are unaffected and never gain the gate implicitly.
requirements.LINT-GD-CONVENTION: The row follows the root godot.toml convention so a target project's policy determines the lint scope, like the boundary gate.
requirements.LINT-GD-FAIL-CLOSED: When gdlint is unavailable in the running environment the check fails rather than silently passing.
requirements.LINT-GD-ENV-POSTURE: The recorded posture that gdtoolkit is absent from the locked harness environment is preserved or explicitly revised with review, never silently changed.
